programme.desc: Meet Lena and Olya Esipovas, a formidable mother-daughter team based in Uzbekistan devoting their lives to saving the saiga – a critically endangered antelope with a distinctive bulbous nose. In 2015 an epidemic tragically wiped out half of the remaining population, killing over 200,000 animals in just a few days, making the work of Lena and Olya and their team of volunteers all the more urgent.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: The Kakapo, or owl parrot, is a large flightless bird found on two New Zealand islands: Codfish Island and Anchor Island. In the 1990s their numbers dropped to as low as 50 birds but this figure is now on the rise. Deidre Vercoe is responsible for running a conservation scheme which monitors each one of the remaining birds to keep them safe and to encourage them to breed.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.sub-title: Anna and the Thresher Sharks (The Philippines)
programme.desc: On the island of Malapascua in the Philippines, Anna Oposa and her team are working with local fisherman to create a nature reserve where thresher sharks can thrive. These sharks are famous for their long tails which they use to whip and stun their prey. Every day, pelagic thresher sharks head to Monad Shoal, a sunken island just off the coast of Malapascua, where other fish “clean” them of their external parasites. This remarkable sight is popular with divers but the numbers of thresher sharks are dwindling and Anna is spearheading the campaign to protect this incredible species in the Philippines.

programme.title: House of Svengoolie
programme.desc: "Revenge of the Creature is, of course, the sequel to Universal's fabulously successful The Creature from the Black Lagoon—and like its predecessor, the film was lensed in 3-D (though released "flat" in most theatres). Though the audience had seen the Gill-Man shot full of holes in the first picture, he still resides in the Black Lagoon in the sequel, apparently none the worse for wear. Two oceanographers (John Bromfield and Robert B. Williams) capture the creature and put him on display at Florida's Ocean Harbor Park (actually Marineland of the Atlantic). Here the hapless Gill-Man is taught a few words of English by compassionate icthyologists John Agar and Lori Nelson. Eventually, however, the creature reverts to type, kills one of his captors and goes on a rampage. And once again, he manages to briefly abduct the heroine and carry her off. Not nearly as good as the first Creature, this followup is saved by the underwater photography of Charles S. Welbourne—and by the effective performance by Ricou Browning as the Gill-Man. "

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de la Nona, el robo de su testamento desata conflictos. Benjamín y Katiuska destruyen el nuevo testamento, sin saber que fueron grabados. Mientras el Dr. Fossi intenta validar una copia no notariada, el Dr. Bruzual la impugna. Las tensiones familiares aumentan: Elizabeth decide confesar la verdad a su padre, Graciela cae en el alcoholismo y Ricardo, engañado por Misael, acusa a Manuela de manipular la herencia, lo que termina en una confrontación física.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Lucas se infiltra en casa de Erasto bajo el disfraz de técnico eléctrico y desconecta la alarma para el plan de rescate. Alejandro lleva a Consuelo a casa y le confirma que su hija está con una hermana de Arminda. Junior, ya consciente, le confiesa a Adolfo episodios previos de desmayo; éste le promete tratamiento en el exterior. Blanca recibe a Consuelo eufuórica con la noticia. Arminda regresa a casa preocupada por la amenaza, mientras Carmen Rosa sueña con el día que mató a un hombre y Arminda la ayudó a huir. Erasto sigue amenazando con cobrarse el dinero perdido contra Eustoquio cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene va a ver a Leonardo a la empresa para decirle que Mateo no es su hijo y para que deje a su familia en paz y arma un escandalo. Ella se siente muy culpable porque le mintió pero cree que es la única manera de proteger a su hijo. Por otro lado Leo insiste conquistar a María Lucía para que le dé otra oportunidad pero ella no quiere, lo rechaza en varias ocasiones. Virginia le cuenta a Carlos Ernesto todo el dolor que vivió pero él la reanima y le promete que serán felices siempre. Leonardo siente que perdió definitivamente a Irene y está muy triste, su hijo Julio le pide que confíe en él y le cuente, así que le confiesa que él no ama a Rebeca sino a Irene.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro logra confesarle a Sol que no son hermanos. Insegura por la situación vivida con Heriberto, Sol se hace estudios para tratar de determinar si tuvieron relaciones. Luego visita a Heriberto en la cárcel, donde él le confiesa que la drogó, pero que no le dio el coraje para abusar de ella. Alicia hace un acuerdo con Cristina para que ella figure como la donante en su trasplante de médula, pero al momento de la operación, Cristina no está. Alicia hace esfuerzos para que no logren sedarla.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En casa de ROKUro todos están llorando por la emotividad de las palabras de ROKUro y Bienvenida. En la casa de Jesica y Junior están Pastor | Fabián y Olegario. También está el Doctor Caridad todos cenando. Se presenta Carolina a pedirle un favor a Junior. Yubiri y Mayerlin se quedaron en la casa | cuidándola mientras que los demás fueron a acompañar a ROKUro. Wilker le trae un dulce a Bienvenida. Entra a la casa y comienza a hablar con Yubiri y s e presenta Mayerlin..

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le revela a Magdalena el secreto que le tenía guardado: Agustín, su marido, es infértil, y por lo tanto, no es el padre de su hijo Rodrigo. Impactada por semejante noticia, Magdalena se pierde por las calles de la ciudad, totalmente desconsolada. Pero lo que no le revelaron, es que Agustín y Sofía, son amantes desde hace años. Angie, celosa de unas flores que recibió Gabriel, finalmente consigue que su novio acepte ir con ella al cocktail de la revista Ricos y Famosos esa misma noche. Pero al final, Gabriel la deja plantada porque va en busca de Magdalena luego de que la llamara y notara su tristeza. Angie entra en cólera por la desaparición de Gabriel y decide ir de todas formas al cocktail y emborracharse.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo y Manuela se enfrentan mientras Misael los confronta por celos. Elizabeth revela que Benjamín es Néstor Cordido, noticia que sorprende a Katiuska. Hortensia acepta casarse con Benjamín en secreto, ignorando que él robó el testamento. Por otro lado, Alejandro es expulsado de la iglesia tras ser visto con Margot. Manuela auxilia a una enferma Celia, quien luego le confirma a Ricardo la verdadera identidad de Benjamín, desenmascarando sus engaños ante el bufete y la familia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa menciona a su tía Arminda y Alejandro une los cabos descubriendo que Rosa es la hija perdida de Consuelo y que espera un hijo de su propio hermano Junior. Los amigos enfrentan a Erasto y rescatan a Natalia. Salvador y Consuelo descubren que el accidente de Leticia fue provocado. Erasto, en su locura, planea entregar a Consuelo su hija a cambio de vivir con él. Alejandro decide hablar primero con Carmen Rosa. Consuelo recibe a Natalia mientras Chencha duda en revelar el secreto. Erasto sale a buscar a Consuelo a su casa.

programme.desc: Sofía le revela a Magdalena el secreto que le tenía guardado: Agustín, su marido, es infértil, y por lo tanto, no es el padre de su hijo Rodrigo. Impactada por semejante noticia, Magdalena se pierde por las calles de la ciudad, totalmente desconsolada. Pero lo que no le revelaron, es que Agustín y Sofía, son amantes desde hace años. Angie, celosa de unas flores que recibió Gabriel, finalmente consigue que su novio acepte ir con ella al cocktail de la revista Ricos y Famosos esa misma noche. Pero al final, Gabriel la deja plantada porque va en busca de Magdalena luego de que la llamara y notara su tristeza. Angie entra en cólera por la desaparición de Gabriel y decide ir de todas formas al cocktail y emborracharse.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo y Manuela se enfrentan mientras Misael los confronta por celos. Elizabeth revela que Benjamín es Néstor Cordido, noticia que sorprende a Katiuska. Hortensia acepta casarse con Benjamín en secreto, ignorando que él robó el testamento. Por otro lado, Alejandro es expulsado de la iglesia tras ser visto con Margot. Manuela auxilia a una enferma Celia, quien luego le confirma a Ricardo la verdadera identidad de Benjamín, desenmascarando sus engaños ante el bufete y la familia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa menciona a su tía Arminda y Alejandro une los cabos descubriendo que Rosa es la hija perdida de Consuelo y que espera un hijo de su propio hermano Junior. Los amigos enfrentan a Erasto y rescatan a Natalia. Salvador y Consuelo descubren que el accidente de Leticia fue provocado. Erasto, en su locura, planea entregar a Consuelo su hija a cambio de vivir con él. Alejandro decide hablar primero con Carmen Rosa. Consuelo recibe a Natalia mientras Chencha duda en revelar el secreto. Erasto sale a buscar a Consuelo a su casa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo descubre toda la verdad sobre Mateo al escuchar a Irene rezando en la iglesia, se entere que él es el padre biológico de Mateo. Leonardo quiere reconocer a ese hijo como suyo y darle los derechos por ser su padre. Irene no quiere saber nada con esto y huye a su casa, donde habla con Felipe acerca de la situación legal de Leonardo y su hijo. María Lucía y Leo hablan en el parque sobre su antigua relación y Leo le confiesa que nunca pudo olvidarla. Mientras tanto, Sandra trata de ocultar este encuentro a su madre Zulay y a Trinidad. Desgraciadamente, aparece Damián, quien también quiere saber dónde se encuentra María Lucía. Rodrigo y Alejandra disputan su plan de acción para poder irse del país a una vida en Europa, pero Alejandra no está del todo convencida de esto.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro anuncian que se van a casar y también que Sol está embarazada. Reina le dice a Sol que Heriberto la violó y que el hijo que espera es de él. Sol recibe una prueba médica que verifica que lo que le dijo Reina es verdad. Heriberto es trasladado, para luego ser llevado a Texas, donde será ejecutado. Durante el trayecto, llama a Sol. Heriberto le repite que no la violó pero la llamada se corta. Alejandro le pregunta a Sol qué pasa y esta le dice que ya no podrán ser felices.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Tommy the Little Dragon
programme.desc: Tommy is a soft toy who lives with an ordinary panda family. Panda parents have no idea about him, while their cubs cannot live a day without Tommy! programme.title: Jenny’s Magic Shop
programme.desc: Jenny and her best friend Blam the Teddy Bear run a magic shop in the town of Dreamville, where everybody can come for magical help. The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.desc: Whitetail deer have a unique four-chambered stomach that helps them digest tough plant material and adapt to seasonal diets. In this episode of Deer & Deer Hunting, Dan Schmidt and Josh Honeycutt break down the whitetail’s digestive system and what it means for you as a hunter.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Kansas doesn’t give up giants easily. After a tough early-season grind chasing Midwest whitetails, HuntStand’s Will Cooper left Kansas with unfinished business. But the season wasn’t over. In December, he returned to face brutal winds, bitter cold, long sits, and a mature Kansas buck that always seemed to stay one step ahead. What started as another trip to the Midwest quickly became a test of patience, persistence, and just how long you’re willing to stay in the game. Because some hunts come together fast. Others make you earn every second of them.

Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.
